name: City St George’s, University of London

facts.text: City, University of London merged with St George's, University of London on 1 August 2024 to become City St George's, University of London.
facts.sourceTitle: About us • City St George's, University of London

facts.text: City St George's educates more than 27,000 students from over 170 countries across three campuses in Clerkenwell, Moorgate and Tooting.
facts.sourceTitle: About us • City St George's, University of London

facts.text: The Lord Mayor of London is the university's Rector, and professional bodies help develop its courses and facilities.
facts.sourceTitle: About us • City St George's, University of London

facts.text: The merger combines St George's specialism in health and medicine with City's strengths in business, law, communications, policy and global affairs, and science and technology, making it one of the most significant suppliers of the health workforce in London.
facts.sourceTitle: About us • City St George's, University of London

facts.text: 70% of its research is rated world-leading (4*) or internationally excellent (3*), it has six specialist Schools, and around half of its students come from outside the UK.
facts.sourceTitle: About us • City St George's, University of London
